自定义类型，取值：

- landmark：自定义地标。

- object：自定义物体。
description.en:
The custom type. Valid values:  

- landmark: Custom landmark.  

- object: Custom object.
The entity ID of the custom library entity.

descriptions.zh:
本接口目前支持的地域为华北2（北京）、华东2（上海）、华东1（杭州），其他地域暂不支持。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
This API currently supports the China (Beijing), China (Shanghai), and China (Hangzhou) regions. Other regions are not supported yet.  

## Queries per second (QPS) limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 50 queries per second (QPS) per user. If you exceed this limit, your API calls will be rate-limited, which may impact your business. Invoke the API appropriately. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342832~~).
